description: B300 index basket — raw per-source price-point capture. The daily composite is computed separately by the compute CLI under calc.methodology_id below. Every parameter is config, not code; see METHODOLOGY.md.
methodology_doc: Annex A (B300 index basket) is published with the contract documents and is not part of this repository; this config pins every parameter of the frozen series.

capture_screens.description: Capture-side data-quality screens (post-collection, pre-upload, flag-only via the implausible machinery). A basket constituent whose lowest eligible print moves >= jump_quarantine_pct vs the previous stored snapshot (native terms) is quarantined for that capture unless >= jump_min_corroborators OTHER constituents moved >= jump_corroborate_pct.

calc.description: Daily composite calculation parameters for methodology annex_a_v0_2_calc_v6. The calculation semantics — per-source daily print, recorded-currency outlier fence, median-of-votes aggregate, dynamic predictive weighting — are specified in METHODOLOGY.md and METHODOLOGY.md section 8. Every parameter here is embedded verbatim in each published artifact and pinned per methodology_id: any change touching a published day requires minting a new methodology_id (frozen predecessors keep their own keyspaces).

bare-metal per-node pricing — normalize per-GPU by the node's stated GPU count. True on-demand hourly is $16.00/GPU-hr ($128/node-hr, 8x); an early $8.00 scoping ballpark was the MONTHLY-COMMIT tier ($46,720/mo = exactly $8.00/GPU-hr effective). Both tiers are captured, clearly labeled; committed tiers are excluded from the underlying rate. Plan stock_level currently 'unavailable' (possibly pre-GA listing).
